text: This is John. How can I help?

What's the price? That's the easiest way for me to find it.
I'm in Baltimore. Local dealer isn't giving me a good deal. I'm trying to get something competitive.
Text is better, but I can give email.
Client advisors send numbers via email first.
Is this a purchase or lease?
Possibly — would the second get loyalty?

Okay — I'll text you. Reply YES to opt in.
Narrator explains the client wants a very specific build.
Yes — sorry, I was scrolling TikTok.
Preferably no more than $5K. Local deal was close with $3,500 down.
Hey Jordan, I'm looking for a car in stock.

Great. When will it be there?

I prefer your white one. If you can beat or match my local deal, I'll buy today.
